findings.title: Chainalysis Security Incident Information
findings.summary_md: Chainalysis published its incident advisory on October 30, 2026, disclosing that an external actor used offensive agentic techniques to access Chainalysis systems and internal tools. At that time the company said non-sensitive customer data (user IDs, full names, email addresses, organization role labels) was accessed and cited no evidence of access to credentials, session tokens, clear-text passwords, or MFA secrets. The advisory was updated on November 4 and November 6 as the exposure scope expanded.

findings.title: Chainalysis says cybersecurity incident exposed some customer data
findings.summary_md: Blockchain.News published the first independent news coverage on October 30, 2026, reporting Chainalysis's statement that some non-sensitive customer data, including user IDs, full names, email addresses, and organization role labels, was accessed. The report noted the company found no evidence of access to investigation content, credentials, or session tokens at that stage.
